# Tree content assertions wait in the owning window and may need separate scroll and fill frames

The changed tests await requestAnimationFrame from about3Pane or the relevant test window after UI updates. Accepted sorting tests explicitly wait once for scrolling and once for the row fill before checking content/selection. A scoped testing recommendation is to wait for the component’s actual frame boundary in its owner window, and distinguish scroll from fill; this does not prove every asynchronous row label is ready after exactly two frames. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/test.
